job: Show what each plan costs and includes, with a monthly or yearly switch.
purpose: Plans as ruled columns, ruled rows or one plan beside its inclusions. The price is the largest thing in a plan; a featured plan has a stronger rule and a label, not a colour of its own. The billing period is an fd-segmented: site.js sets data-period and shows the prices and units marked with it, and fires fd:change. Inclusions are an fd-feature-list.
useWhen: The pricing page or the pricing section of a landing page.

avoidWhen.when: Choosing or changing a plan in the app's billing settings.
Plans that differ in more than five ways.

states.name: period
states.how: data-period="monthly|yearly" on the section (site.js); elements with another data-period get hidden

variants.useWhen: Two to four plans side by side.
One plan and what it includes.
On a plan: the one most teams pick; a stronger rule and a label.

parts.role: The segmented control and its note.

keyboard.does: In the period control: choose monthly or yearly.

relation.because: The plan card is for choosing a plan inside the app; this section sets public prices on ruled columns with a period switch.
